name: vsc-agentbridge
description: Expose your VS Code workspace tools (files, terminal, LSP, diagnostics) to web-based AI assistants that support MCP (GPT, Arena, etc.) via a public HTTPS tunnel.

enumDescriptions: Follow the VS Code display language.
Force AgentBridge's own interface and runtime messages to Simplified Chinese.
Force AgentBridge's own interface and runtime messages to English.
agentbridge.language.description: Controls the language of AgentBridge's own panel and runtime messages. VS Code-native command and settings titles continue to follow the VS Code display language.

agentbridge.bridge.ngrokDomain.description: Reserved ngrok HTTPS hostname used by the Bridge, for example your-name.ngrok-free.dev. Stored as an application-wide user setting so a workspace cannot override the Bridge's public identity.

agentbridge.bridge.cloudflareNamedDomain.description: Fixed HTTPS hostname configured as a Cloudflare Tunnel published application, for example mcp.example.com. Stored as an application-wide user setting so a workspace cannot override the Bridge's public identity.

agentbridge.bridge.cloudflareNamedLocalP.description: Fixed localhost port used by Cloudflare Named Tunnel on this machine. This machine-specific setting is not synchronized or workspace-overridable. Configure the Cloudflare published application Service URL as http://127.0.0.1:<port>.

agentbridge.bridge.managedShell.windows.description: Absolute path to the shell executable that AgentBridge managed PTY terminals will launch on Windows (e.g. C:\Program Files\PowerShell\7\pwsh.exe for PowerShell 7+, or C:\Windows\System32\cmd.exe for cmd). Leave empty to use the default system Windows PowerShell (powershell.exe). AgentBridge validates the path at apply time and silently falls back to the default with a warning in the panel when the override cannot be launched.

agentbridge.bridge.managedShell.unix.description: Absolute path or PATH-resolvable name of the shell executable that AgentBridge managed PTY terminals will launch on POSIX systems (e.g. /bin/zsh, /usr/bin/fish, or simply bash). Leave empty to use the default /bin/bash (or /bin/sh when bash is unavailable). AgentBridge resolves the binary via PATH when the value is not absolute and silently falls back to the default with a warning in the panel when the override cannot be launched.

enumDescriptions: ChatGPT and arena.ai open inside the VS Code Simple Browser; other external links jump to the OS default browser.
Every external link opens inside the VS Code Simple Browser, including Cloudflare/ngrok dashboards. OAuth login flows may be blocked by iframe X-Frame-Options restrictions.
Every external link jumps to the OS default browser. Equivalent to the pre-stage-14 behavior.
agentbridge.bridge.openInternalBrowser.description: Decides how external URL links clicked in the AgentBridge panel (ChatGPT/Arena buttons, Cloudflare/ngrok dashboard buttons, etc.) are opened.

enumDescriptions: Cloudflare Quick Tunnel. No account or domain required; the public URL changes after restart.
Cloudflare Named Tunnel. Stable hostname; requires a Cloudflare account, managed domain, Tunnel Token, and published application route.
ngrok reserved domain. Requires an ngrok account, Authtoken, and configured domain.
agentbridge.bridge.tunnelProvider.description: Public tunnel provider used by AgentBridge.

enumDescriptions: cloudflared chooses the transport itself (QUIC first, HTTP/2 fallback). QUIC handshakes can pass on networks that later drop sustained UDP flows, so this may stay unstable on some campus/corporate networks.
Force QUIC over UDP 7844. Fastest when the network allows long-lived UDP flows; rarely survives restrictive networks.
Force HTTP/2 over TCP 7844. Recommended on networks where QUIC is unstable or blocked (campus/corporate networks, VPNs). Cloudflare's edge accepts both transports on the same port.
agentbridge.bridge.tunnelProtocol.description: Transport protocol between cloudflared and the Cloudflare edge. Cloudflare tunnels only (ignored for ngrok). Read when the tunnel process spawns, so changes apply on the next tunnel start or automatic reconnect without restarting the Bridge.

agentbridge.bridge.persistentMode.description: Automatically start the Bridge after the extension activates.

agentbridge.bridge.readOnlyMode.description: Enable read-only mode. When active, tools that modify the local environment (apply_patch, run_command, send_command_input, terminate_command) are hidden from tools/list and hard-blocked at call time. Takes effect immediately; connected clients see the change after they refresh their tool list.
